s: Din chatzerot ubattim benehem ubo b' seipim: b' chatzerot veg' battim benehen petuchim zo lezo, verotzin kullan leareb yachad — hare ben chatzer zo ba derek bayit happatuach lachatzero venoten erubo babbayit haemtzai veoseh et bayit happatuach lachatzero kebet shaar lachatzero laabor derek alayv lehaemtzai, veken ben chatzer haacheret ba derek bayit happatuach lah venoten erub behaemtzai veoseh et bayit happatuach lachatzero kebet shaar lachatzero, veen echad mig' battim ellu tzarik litten pat laerub, ki shenayim hassemukim lachatzerot hem kebet shaar, ubet shaar eno oser, vehaemtzai hu bayit shemmannichim bo et haerub veeno tzarik litten et happat. Veyesh omerim sheapillu natenu erub beechad mibbattim hassemukim lachatzerot, o apillu beechad mibbatte hachatzerot atzman — en g' battim ellu tzerikim litten pat, lepi shennaasu kullam kebet shaar leotah chatzer hammoleket erubah derek alehem lechatzer haacheret:

B' chatzerot ub' battim benehem, velo erebu yachad ella kol achat leatzmah, vekol chatzer lo notna erubah babbayit happatuach lah ella asaattu bet shaar uba derek bayit sheetzlo venatan eruba babbayit hassamuk lechatzer haacheret, veken asa ben chatzer hashsheniyya, sheggam hu hinniach erubo babbayit hassamuk lechatzer haacheret — lo qanu erub, shekkol echad hinniach erubo bebet shaar shel chatzer acheret, veeno erub, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v:
